arStrings.szText: This stone was spat from the belly of Tal Rasha’s tomb.
He was the first of us. Kulle called him noble, selfless. Deckard Cain called him valorous. Tyrael called him wise, and chose him as our leader.
And he suffered for it. For centuries, he wrestled with Baal. This time, there were no casualties, save for Tal Rasha himself, or rather, what was left of his humanity, and all that made him good.
It shall surprise no one that Baal escaped anyway.
We have coped without a leader. Yet I fear we have not completely salvaged the hope that died with our first.
